name: Páfrány · Tölgy és smaragdzöld
palette: Pale natural oak with closely spaced vertical flutes, soft concrete-grey woven fabric, forest-green velvet, muted bronze, white stone appearance with grey veins. Match the colour balance and grain scale in PF01–04.
living_design: Reproduce the PF01–02 grey finely woven sofa, simple slim arms and emerald accent cushions within the existing seating footprint. Give the existing full-height storage pale vertical oak fluted fronts and one narrow, useful bronze-backed illuminated display niche with glassware, not a new bar occupying circulation. The TV field is the quiet grey field paired with oak storage: this TV adaptation is designed for the apartment because the reference does not show a complete TV wall. Use a small round pale-stone coffee table, slim bronze base, grey upholstered dining chairs and restrained black continuous-line art on the existing art wall. Bring in the reference green velvet as a chair only if the control already has a chair position; otherwise express it on cushions. Keep the sofa light grey, not green. Finish with tailored light-grey curtains, white translucent sheers and a textured grey rug.
bed_design: Copy PF04 faithfully: a tall pale oak fluted headboard field with alternating shallow ribs, a slim brown upholstered bed, olive-grey satin-matte bedding, white folded pillows, dark forest-green floor-length curtains and small round bronze bedside tables. The wall treatment remains on the existing headboard wall; do not create the reference dressing room doorway. Full-height wardrobes use matching quiet oak fronts and bronze grips. Preserve the own room bed size and circulation. Conceal a warm headboard graze within the joinery; use the required Hue Go pair at the existing bedside positions.
kitchen_design: Transfer PF02 pale oak tall fronts, quiet matte-grey upper and lower units, white-and-grey veined worktop and splashback to the actual apartment kitchen. Preserve appliance, sink and hob positions and every existing working run. Place grey upholstered chairs around the approved table; give the table the quiet grey top and restrained bronze detail of the reference. A slender horizontal glass-and-bronze pendant may occupy the existing dining supply only. No reference island, new stool row or curved floor replacement.
entry_design: Copy the PF03 fluted oak storage and padded grey bench recess with a softly rounded front corner, bronze-backed hooks and concealed shoe storage into the existing entry cabinet footprint. If no bench recess fits, retain closed full-height storage and translate the niche into a shallow existing furniture bay; never obstruct a door. Continue the same oak rhythm down the existing hallway cabinets.
bath_design: Use the PF14/PF25 crescent mirror and floating wood vanity as an explicitly borrowed bathroom companion to the oak/green scheme; their original association with PF01–04 is unconfirmed. Apply pale oak fronts with restrained bronze edging, a white integrated basin and useful slim storage. The black crescent mirror gives a distinctive graphic detail; add a small green glazed vessel and neatly folded grey towels. Keep all existing room tiles.
wardrobe_design: Copy the PF03 fluted oak storage and padded grey bench recess with a softly rounded front corner, bronze-backed hooks and concealed shoe storage into the existing entry cabinet footprint. If no bench recess fits, retain closed full-height storage and translate the niche into a shallow existing furniture bay; never obstruct a door. Continue the same oak rhythm down the existing hallway cabinets. In a dedicated wardrobe retain the existing full-height storage layout, practical hanging lengths, drawers, mirror and access to every door. Closed storage remains dominant; no decorative niche may remove the usable storage requirement.
hall_design: Copy the PF03 fluted oak storage and padded grey bench recess with a softly rounded front corner, bronze-backed hooks and concealed shoe storage into the existing entry cabinet footprint. If no bench recess fits, retain closed full-height storage and translate the niche into a shallow existing furniture bay; never obstruct a door. Continue the same oak rhythm down the existing hallway cabinets. Extend the same material rhythm to every existing hallway cabinet and finish exposed end panels neatly to the actual ceiling, retaining service access.
utility_design: Preserve actual washing machine, dryer, water and ventilation positions. Use moisture-resistant closed fronts matching this scheme, a usable laundry work surface only where the control shows one, accessible maintenance panels and practical warm-neutral cabinet task light. Keep any actual sink in place and do not invent one. Store laundry products behind full-height doors; one open towel bay is sufficient.

name: Páfrány · Bronz galéria
palette: Soft champagne-bronze sheet, off-white narrow fluting, medium grey-brown timber, white mineral surfaces with grey veins, pearl woven upholstery, restrained black-and-white patterned textile and powder-blue dining accents.
living_design: Match PF09 and its reverse composition PF24: a broad rectangular brushed champagne-bronze TV field, surrounded by off-white fine vertical fluting and slim open shelving with white-grey veined backs. A continuous low pale cabinet anchors the composition and concealed shelf grazes make its material depth legible. Keep the TV in its approved position. Upholster the fixed sofa in pearl-white woven fabric, gently rounding module ends without moving the sofa; add two small black-and-white patterned cushions and one muted taupe cushion. Use two overlapping round grey mineral coffee tables within the actual free space. Place the reference fine-stem glass-globe pendant only at the existing ceiling point with suitable clearance. Tailored ivory curtains and sheers, a softly irregular pale rug and a restrained vase complete the room. Do not import PF24 fireplace, staircase, double room length or garden view.
bed_design: Match PF05: a large softly rounded rectangular ivory vertically ribbed headboard surround, luminous only along its concealed inner rim, backed by the mottled grey-brown stone-appearance panel. The upholstered bed has a slim rectangular profile and a black-and-white small-scale patterned headboard inset, soft grey bedding and a pale rug. Use medium grey-brown full-height wardrobe fronts with a limited bronze-framed smoked-glass display bay; a serviceable door remains visible. Keep light-coloured sheer and taupe curtain layers. The required Hue Go pair sits on the existing bedside tables and the approximately three-metre warm concealed headboard strip follows the joinery, not the ceiling.
kitchen_design: Match PF06/PF12 grey-brown full-height timber cabinetry, warm-grey flat upper fronts, white grey-veined work surface and pale stone dining tabletop on a slim bronze rectangular support. Translate the powder-blue accent of the reference stools into the apartment dining-chair upholstery if no approved bar seating exists. An opal/glass bead-strand pendant may replace the existing dining fixture at the same outlet; its mounting is conditional. Preserve the real U-shaped kitchen and all appliance positions; no freestanding reference island.
entry_design: Adapt the PF07 large shallow quarter-circle joinery relief framing a pale padded bench niche. Keep the curve within the existing cabinet face; it is not a new arch or altered doorway. Use bronze-framed smoked glass on one closed wardrobe bay, brown timber bench backing and pale ribbed adjoining fronts. Light the useful coat and shoe niche softly; retain actual door widths and clearances.
bath_design: Copy PF14/PF25 floating grey-brown timber vanity, white integrated rectangular basin and black crescent circular mirror in front of a narrow bronze backing panel. Reproduce the slim lit storage idea as an accessible furniture tower without cutting new wall recesses. Existing tiles remain; the reference mottled stone may only appear on a removable dry furniture backing where allowed. Add a tiny branch vase and ribbed soap dish.
wardrobe_design: Adapt the PF07 large shallow quarter-circle joinery relief framing a pale padded bench niche. Keep the curve within the existing cabinet face; it is not a new arch or altered doorway. Light the useful coat and shoe niche softly; retain actual door widths and clearances. In a dedicated wardrobe retain the existing full-height storage layout, practical hanging lengths, drawers, mirror and access to every door. Closed storage remains dominant; no decorative niche may remove the usable storage requirement.

Use bronze-framed smoked glass on one closed wardrobe bay, brown timber bench backing and pale ribbed adjoining fronts. Light the useful coat and shoe niche softly; retain actual door widths and clearances. Extend the same material rhythm to every existing hallway cabinet and finish exposed end panels neatly to the actual ceiling, retaining service access.
utility_design: Preserve actual washing machine, dryer, water and ventilation positions. Keep any actual sink in place and do not invent one. Store laundry products behind full-height doors; one open towel bay is sufficient.

living_design: Copy PF10 directly: an ivory narrowly fluted TV field in a slim bronze rectangular border, flanked by slender brown timber illuminated display bays and a white low drawer cabinet. Preserve all approved TV-wall openings and cabinet endpoints. The sofa remains in the exact control footprint with creamy subtly bouclé upholstery and softly curved outer edges; repeat the reference restrained black-and-white patterned back cushions. Place a thin dark elliptical coffee table on a fine base and a pale tactile rug. Use one compact patterned chair only where the control has a chair. A fine black balanced-arm opal-globe fixture uses the existing supply point, scaled below the real ceiling. Full-height ivory curtains and sheers keep the shell bright. Avoid converting this scheme into the bronze-central-panel PB option.
bed_design: Copy PF08: a white stone-appearance full-height headboard panel with clearly readable grey and muted gold veins, a cream upholstered bed with subtle repeated rounded geometric stitching, two brown/taupe cushions and a narrow black-and-white patterned textile strip. The bedside pieces are white cylinders with restrained bronze rims. Keep a pale deep-textured rug, white sheers and warm grey curtains. Full-height wardrobe fronts combine brown timber fluting with a limited bronze smoked-glass bay. A concealed warm edge graze frames the headboard without creating a ceiling cove; keep the owner’s Hue Go pair and an approximately three-metre joinery-mounted headboard strip.
kitchen_design: Use PF11: a warm taupe-bronze full-height cabinet surround, brown vertically grained upper doors, ivory lower units and a white-grey veined splashback and counter. Bring the sea-green reference stool accent into the existing dining chairs, not a new breakfast island. Keep the approved dining-table footprint with a pale top. The original ring-light idea becomes a single restrained ring pendant at the documented dining outlet, subject to hanging clearance. Preserve the existing straight flooring transition; the reference curved terrazzo floor is inspiration only and is not a replacement of the apartment floor.
entry_design: Copy PF15 pale fine-fluted full-height fronts, bronze-framed smoked-glass coat storage and small floating timber display shelves within the existing cabinetry. Use a shallow curved bronze-edged decorative furniture panel at the cabinet end without redrawing the doorway. A small sea-green pouf may occupy only an existing clear seat location. Provide real shoe drawers, accessible coat hanging and discreet furniture-mounted light.
bath_design: Translate PF13 warm bronze cabinetry, fine vertical fluting and dark large-chip terrazzo accent into a limited dry vanity backing and a small removable tray, keeping existing wall and floor tiles. Replace the reference pedestal basin with the required integrated white basin in a floating warm-brown vanity. Use a refined oval mirror and one smoked/opal globe wall lamp only at a verified existing connection. Retain the one-metre clear shower screen rather than copying opaque ribbed glass that hides the actual shower. No invented freestanding bathtub. Two sculptural black vessels and a warm mirror halo create the reference mood.
wardrobe_design: Copy PF15 pale fine-fluted full-height fronts, bronze-framed smoked-glass coat storage and small floating timber display shelves within the existing cabinetry. Closed storage remains dominant; no decorative niche may remove the usable storage requirement.

palette: Pale oak, warm ivory flat cabinetry, olive-green soft upholstery, chalk-white geometric relief, white stone with restrained veins, brushed brass, small cobalt-blue accents and tobacco leather details.
living_design: Match PF16/PF17: olive-green softly rounded upholstered sofa modules within the apartment’s locked sofa footprint, a low round pale travertine-appearance coffee table, one slim brass side table and a cream lounge chair only in an already approved chair position. Create the reference large chalk-white geometric relief on the actual art wall using shallow rectangular and circular segments. The existing TV cabinet becomes pale oak with quiet ivory lower storage; integrate a slim book-display bay only inside the approved joinery. Use the existing dining envelope for an oval-ended oak table with olive and grey wraparound chairs. Keep warm taupe curtains, white sheers and an understated pale rug. A single fine brass ring or balanced-arm fixture uses only the existing ceiling outlet. Do not copy the villa staircase, floor-to-ceiling divider across circulation or new tall tree.
bed_design: Match PF21: a pale white stone-appearance headboard panel with sparse soft grey veining, a slim grey upholstered bed and muted olive-grey bedding. Keep the reference vertical oak-fin detail as a short side panel on the existing headboard wall, never as a new room divider. Use a small dark round bedside table and a restrained black line-art panel on a visible existing wall. Full-height pale greige wardrobes have oak internal reveals and useful warm lit storage inspired by PF22. Include the original approximately three-metre headboard-strip intent and Hue Go bedside pair at real power points. Warm-grey curtains and sheers complete the room.
kitchen_design: Copy PF18/PF19/PF20 ivory full-height flat cabinetry with a quiet pale oak upper band, pale white subtly veined worktop and a refined brass tap at the existing sink. Transfer the cobalt-blue stool upholstery to dining seats only where bar seats are not already present. Keep the actual U-shaped working runs and appliances. The dining table remains the approved size, with rounded oak ends and olive/grey chair backs. A slender brass-and-black balanced pendant hangs from the existing outlet, not new tracks. Retain the apartment floor and window frames.
entry_design: Translate PF22 wardrobe practicality into the actual entry and corridor cabinets: pale greige closed full-height fronts, warm oak shelf interiors, slender brass grips, integrated diffuse rail lighting and one useful mirror. The photographed open walk-in arrangement is not copied into a narrow hallway. Preserve all door swings and utility access. Continue the PF16 shallow geometric relief on a small existing panel only where it does not replace needed storage.
bath_design: Adapt PF23 white mineral character and warm bronze detail into the dry vanity backing, using an integrated white basin over pale oak/ivory storage. Existing tile and sanitary positions stay. Use a rectangular backlit mirror with a fine bronze edge and one accessible slim wall cabinet; no new freestanding tub. A small olive ceramic vessel, folded white towels and a diffused under-vanity pool of light complete the calm design.
